Communicative grammar is a comparatively new trend in the field of English language teaching The main difference between conventional and communicative grammar is characterized by the teaching and learning approaches. The traditional grammar book explains the rules and focuses on usage while communicative grammar presents items in contexts and creates opportunities to use the language accurately as well as fluently Thus, communicative grammar promotes accuracy alongside fluency and helps develop language acquisition.
